why: Found at the build's first run of I88-P2's test on the generated records. The records of the three laws whose hypotheses are HypB and HypT passed every assertion; the O8 pair's two records failed schema validity. The test asserts both that each record is valid against spec/schemas/result_record_v2.schema.json and that its model_assumptions equal the law's hypothesis names (contract rule D2 states both). But the schema's model_assumptions items match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*$ (letters, digits and '-', as A-env or Hyp-Z0-kzg), and the sidecar's names for the O8 pair, HypC_binds_trailing and HypC_ignores_trailing, contain '_'. So no record of those two laws can satisfy both assertions. The schema is a shared file that the contract's commit rules forbid I88 to change, and the sidecar is a pinned instrument. The amended assertion compares model_assumptions with the hypothesis names with each '_' written '-' (holon.derivation.laws.assumption_id). The sidecar's names contain no '-', so the map is one to one and a record still names exactly its law's hypotheses; for HypB and HypT it is the identity. Nothing else changes: status UNKNOWN, the statement hash, schema validity, the two attempts and every other assertion are as preregistered.

Found with the P2 amendment above, before either was committed. The contract's route for a wrong instrument is a line in spec/M3/amendments.jsonl (its docstring: 'a wrong instrument is a Question and a line in spec/M3/amendments.jsonl'; the lane rules say the same). But rule R2 forbids any own commit to change spec/ other than spec/schemas/law_ir_0_3.schema.json, so taking that route would itself fail R2. I69's R2 (tests_m3/test_bundle_extraction.py) carves out exactly this case. The amended assertion lets an own commit modify spec/M3/amendments.jsonl only by appending lines whose iteration is I88 and whose kind is instrument_inconsistency. Every other path rule of R2 is unchanged.
